sealed_statement.family: For every k>=2 there is a source-valid P7-free state K_k with one connected Q_ALL block and optional forcing set {l1,...,l_{k-1}}.
sealed_statement.reachability: Every subset F of the optional forcing set is reachable by authorized repeated forcing li=1, every prefix is globally SAT, and lk is retained so Q_ALL remains connected.
sealed_statement.profile_count: After B2B2-A confluence, B2B2-B new-seed identity erasure and all B2B1 canonical returns, the 2^(k-1) subsets F yield pairwise distinct canonical effect profiles.
sealed_statement.injection: The residual component carrier [z] canonically marks the R side; surviving left li have distinct R-degrees i, so the final profile uniquely recovers F.
sealed_statement.component_control: The residual singleton component has constant compiled C0/C2/C3/B2A behavior across the family; the exponential count is not created by changing component message identities.
sealed_statement.cross_block_control: Every state in the family remains inside one connected Q_ALL block, so the multiplicity is not a product of B2B2-C disconnected blocks.

P7_free_proof_core.chain_part: L union R union {z} is a chain graph with nested neighborhoods and hence contains no induced P5.
P7_free_proof_core.seed_vertex: s4 is adjacent to every L/R vertex, so any induced path containing s4 cannot contain a nonconsecutive L/R vertex without a chord.
P7_free_proof_core.leaf_seed: t has degree one to s4, so no induced P7 can be created through t.

reachability_witness.for_every_F: color all L with 1, all R with 2, z with 3, s4 with 4, t with 3
reachability_witness.meaning: Every forced subset state is nonterminal SAT and therefore genuinely reachable.

critical_firewalls: Exponential canonical profile count is NOT a strong representation-complexity lower bound.
No future R1/R2 distinguishability theorem is included.
The family may still admit a polynomial exact behavioral carrier.
The O(k)-size forced-assignment/reconstruction ledger is not an exponential representation obstruction.
B2B2-E must test exact future behavioral equivalence/distinguishability before any strong negative promotion.
